name: Smarter Furnishings
old_description: From custom designs to existing collections, we simplify the complex world of contract furniture so you can focus on the bigger picture. Whether it’s student housing, hospitality, or beyond, our goal is to make every project smoother, every partnership stronger, and every space
about:
Smarter Furnishings is based in Alabaster, Alabama. The company is owned by three partners—Brian Tipton (Chief Customer Officer), Dean Harvison (Chief Growth Officer), and Johnny Collins (Chief Executive Officer)—who remain actively involved in daily operations. While the founding year is not publicly disclosed, the ownership group emphasizes hands-on leadership across estimating, installation, and follow-up.

The firm supplies contract furniture for collegiate, hospitality, and government environments, offering both custom designs and prefabricated collections. Production runs on a 12- to 16-week lead time after drawing and finish approvals, and the company backs its products with a 25-year warranty. Services extend to on-campus and off-campus furniture installation, as well as project estimating and management.

Clients include universities outfitting student housing, hotels and resorts, and government agencies. Testimonials reference projects such as student room furniture for stakeholders and luxury apartment installations, highlighting the company's focus on durable, non-standard dorm-style pieces with quality wood finishes.

Smarter Furnishings positions itself on simplifying the procurement of contract furniture, with senior leadership directly overseeing each project from planning through installation. The company cites on-time delivery, a 25-year warranty, and hands-on owner involvement as key differentiators.

name: Snap Gourmet Foods, Inc.
old_description: Majority Partners and Founders Jason Chamoun, Allan Lam, and Lincoln Yee founded Snap Gourmet Foods in the heart of the pandemic in 2020 to create an Oasis in the middle of a food desert in Cleveland.
about:
Snap Gourmet Foods, Inc. was founded in 2020 in Cleveland, Ohio, by majority partners Jason Chamoun, Allan Lam, and Lincoln Yee. The trio launched the company during the pandemic with the goal of creating an oasis in a local food desert.

The company operates a USDA-inspected facility spanning 40,000 square feet of production space. It specializes in co-manufacturing packaged food products, including wrapped sandwiches, pizzas, and other hand-held items. Capabilities include sealing food or food components in clear bags, producing shelf-stable, refrigerated, and frozen meals and meal kits for local and nationwide distribution. The business also runs a full-service catering and pre-plating foodservice division, handling events from 20 to 1,000 guests and providing chef-inspired meals for private schools, preschools, and corporate cafeterias.

Snap Gourmet serves a range of institutional and commercial customers. Its meal kits and food boxes are supplied to schools, food banks, and aging agencies to address food insecurity. The catering arm supports private schools, preschools, corporate cafeterias, and off-site events, offering cuisines from Italian and Latin to Asian, with gluten-free, vegan, and other dietary accommodations.

The founders, veterans of the food industry who previously founded Symba Brand Solutions and International Food Solutions, state a mission to lead in healthy, quality packaged meal solutions. They emphasize quality, local ingredient sourcing, and the ability to meet diverse dietary needs as key differentiators.

name: Solar Alliance
old_description: Solar Alliance is your engineering, procurement and construction source for solar projects on every scale – from large commercial installations to solar for small businesses.  The Solar Alliance team is committed to helping you meet corporate mandates, evaluate and conserve current energy usage, then save money with solar. Solar Alliance is your source for solar power design in the Southeast and beyond. With years of experience in project management and professionals certified by the North American Board of Energy Practitioners (NABCEP), we have the ability to provide solutions for your commercial solar project anywhere in North America.
about:
Solar Alliance is headquartered in Knoxville, Tennessee. The company does not publicly disclose its founding year, ownership structure, or the names of its founders. It presents itself as an engineering, procurement, and construction (EPC) provider for solar projects of all scales, serving the Southeast and broader North American market.

The firm delivers turnkey solar solutions that encompass design, procurement, construction, and ongoing maintenance. Its service portfolio includes commercial rooftop and ground-mount installations, community solar projects, and integration of energy storage systems. Solar Alliance emphasizes project management, utility interconnection coordination, and troubleshooting, supported by professionals certified by the North American Board of Energy Practitioners (NABCEP). The company also offers a Solar 101 continuing education class for industry professionals.

Solar Alliance serves clients across manufacturing, data centers, professional buildings, agriculture, utilities, and nonprofit sectors such as churches. Reference projects include a solar installation for AAMCO in Lebanon, Tennessee; a system for Faith Lutheran Church in Oak Ridge, Tennessee; and a renewable energy project for TENTE Casters, Inc. in Hebron, Kentucky. The company also partners with local utilities on community solar developments.

According to the company, its differentiation lies in deep project management experience, NABCEP-certified staff, and established relationships with utilities that streamline interconnection. Solar Alliance states it focuses on designing solutions that meet specific business cases, delivering on time and on budget, and building long-term professional relationships rather than simply installing hardware.

name: Solar Alternatives, Inc.
old_description: Since 2008, Solar Alternatives has proudly helped thousands of commercial and residential property owners across Louisiana install modern solar panel systems that strengthen a property’s energy efficiency and overall value.
about:
Solar Alternatives, Inc. operates from New Orleans, Louisiana, where it was founded in 2008. The company began by helping property owners across Louisiana install modern solar panel systems to improve energy efficiency and property value.

The firm designs and installs solar photovoltaic systems, battery storage, and electric-vehicle charging equipment for both residential and commercial customers. Its services cover custom system engineering, installation, ongoing maintenance, panel cleaning, and 24-hour emergency response for safety-related issues. The company reports having served thousands of commercial and residential properties throughout Louisiana.

Solar Alternatives serves homeowners and businesses in the New Orleans metropolitan area and across the state. Its residential clients seek lower utility bills, outage protection, and energy independence, while commercial customers pursue similar efficiency and resilience goals. The company cites the region's 216 annual sunny days and frequent grid outages as key drivers for local demand.

The company emphasizes its team of expert engineers and certified installers who understand New Orleans' specific climate and regulatory environment. Differentiators include custom-designed systems matched to each property's energy profile, certified product selections, comprehensive warranties, and responsive maintenance support. The business was built on the premise that every property owner in the region should have access to reliable, renewable energy.

name: Solar Heat & Electric
old_description: All across the great plains, there is a sunny change in attitude towards solar energy. Quantum improvements in technology are driving down cost. Citizens clamor to minimize the burning of fossil fuels. State governments issue sizable tax credit (30%) to accelerate savings even more.
about:
Solar Heat & Electric operates from Omaha, Nebraska, where it was founded in 1983 by solar visionary Michael Shonka. The company began with solar thermal and energy conservation services before adding solar electric as the technology matured. Shonka, a NABCEP Certified Solar PV Installer, has taught at universities across eastern Nebraska and remains closely associated with solar trade groups.

The firm designs and installs photovoltaic systems for grid-tie applications, scaling from residential rooftops to utility-scale arrays. Its process covers site evaluation, system engineering, permitting, and installation. Recent projects include multiple 25 kW and 50 kW installations, a 200-module array on the Lincoln Electric Systems Service Center, and Nebraska's first center-pivot irrigation solar system (25 kW). The company also developed the state's first solar training curriculum for community colleges.

Customers span residential homeowners, agricultural operators, commercial facilities, municipal governments, educational institutions, and federal agencies. Concrete examples include the Winnebago Police/Fire Station (in collaboration with the Ponca Tribe), Central City's community solar project, Bellevue Police Station, the Army Corps of Engineers' water-pumping arrays, Creighton University's Kiewit Fitness Center, and Metropolitan Community College's Solar Lab.

The company emphasizes its three-decade track record as Nebraska's oldest and most recognized solar installer, with Shonka's university teaching and NABCEP certification lowering project risk. It positions itself as a long-proven expert for clients seeking to reduce fossil-fuel dependence and lock in electricity costs for 25+ years.

old_description: A community solar program through Solar On Earth allows anyone (residential or commercial and regardless if you rent or own) to opt into a local community solar energy farm. The local solar farm allows you to take advantage of solar power without rooftop panels. You will help reduce emissions and lower your utility bill through solar credits.
about:
Solar On Earth operates from its headquarters in Chelmsford, Massachusetts, with a second office in Chadwick, Illinois. The company’s founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed, nor are its founders named in available materials.

The firm administers community solar subscription programs that allow residential and commercial customers to access electricity generated by local solar farms without installing rooftop panels. Subscribers receive utility bill credits tied to their share of a farm’s output. The company manages enrollment, ongoing account support, and coordination with utility providers across more than a dozen states.

Solar On Earth serves homeowners, renters, and businesses in Massachusetts, New York, Maryland, Maine, Hawaii, Illinois, Minnesota, Colorado, Vermont, Delaware, New Jersey, Rhode Island, and New Hampshire. Customers include both residential and commercial accounts seeking to reduce emissions and lower electricity costs through state-authorized community solar programs.

The company emphasizes a guided enrollment process and continued support to help subscribers maintain savings, and it cites an A+ rating from the Better Business Bureau as a mark of service quality.

name: Solar Panel Company
old_description: Switch to clean, renewable solar energy and stop overpaying for electricity. Solar Panel Company in Boston designs and installs custom solar and roofing systems for homeowners across Greater Boston – backed by certified local experts and a 25-year performance guarantee.
about:
Solar Panel Company operates from Boston, Massachusetts, serving homeowners throughout Greater Boston and surrounding communities. The company has spent years helping Massachusetts residents transition to renewable energy, though a specific founding year is not publicly disclosed. Ownership structure and founder names have not been shared.

The firm designs and installs custom rooftop solar arrays, solar heat pumps, home battery systems, EV charging stations, insulation and air-sealing upgrades, and solar shading. It also provides full roofing services — installation, repair, and maintenance — allowing customers to bundle roof work with solar projects. All work is performed in-house by the company's own certified crews; no subcontractors are used. The team manages permitting, utility coordination, and ongoing system monitoring, delivering a single-point-of-contact experience from consultation through activation.

The customer base consists exclusively of residential property owners in the Greater Boston area. Typical clients are homeowners seeking to lower electricity bills — often by 50 to 80 percent — gain backup power during New England storms, or modernize their home's energy infrastructure. The company also assists clients in accessing the federal Solar Investment Tax Credit, the Massachusetts SMART program, and net-metering credits.

Solar Panel Company distinguishes itself by refusing subcontractors, eliminating hidden fees, and backing every installation with a 25-year performance guarantee. A dedicated project contact stays with the homeowner from start to finish, and the firm coordinates roofing and solar work in a single engagement to reduce scheduling conflicts and improve long-term system performance.

name: Solar Panel Store
old_description: Locally owned and operated in Colorado since 2002--Everything You Need to Go Solar!
about:
Solar Panel Store was founded in 2002 in New Castle, Colorado, as a locally owned and operated retailer specializing in solar power equipment. The company began with a focus on providing comprehensive solar solutions for off-grid, grid-tied, RV, and marine applications.

The store stocks a wide range of components including large and small solar panels, charge controllers, batteries, mounting hardware such as top-of-pole mounts and bonding hardware, and related accessories. It carries brands such as Go Power!, MidNite Solar, IronRidge, HelioLug, and Tamarack. The business operates from a facility on River Frontage Road and fulfills orders through its e-commerce platform, emphasizing quick shipping and responsive technical support.

Customers include homeowners installing off-grid or grid-tied systems, RV and boat owners seeking mobile power, and installers sourcing UL-listed components. The company’s blog addresses topics such as Colorado’s plug-in solar legislation and nighttime power draw, indicating engagement with residential and small-commercial markets.

Solar Panel Store distinguishes itself through a locally owned, customer-first approach, offering personalized guidance—such as pre-sale consultation on system sizing—and a curated selection of UL-listed products. The founder’s original aim was to make solar accessible by providing “everything you need to go solar” under one roof.
